description: Make DeepSeek Harness delegation discoverable without loading a skill or custom Codex subagent.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "DeepSeek/DSH delegation is available through a three-process MCP pool: helpme_dsh, helpme_dsh_2, and helpme_dsh_3. Use distinct instances for independent parallel tasks. Never run the same session concurrently, and do not parallelize write-capable tasks in the same workspace. Defaults and controls are self-described by each MCP. Treat 'DeepSeek subagent' as this pool, not a Codex custom subagent."
